{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter out refunded orders
df_filtered = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Parse revenue (strip commas)
df_filtered['revenue_float'] = df_filtered['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for QA orders after filtering refunded
qa_orders_filtered = df_filtered[df_filtered['revenue_float'] == 999999.99]
print(f"Number of QA orders after filtering refunded: {len(qa_orders_filtered)}")

# Compute conversion rates by channel and customer_segment
segmented_conversion = df_filtered.groupby(['customer_segment', 'channel'])['converted'].mean().unstack(level='channel')

# Compute difference within each segment: email - paid_search
segment_diff = segmented_conversion['email'] - segmented_conversion['paid_search']

# Compute segment sizes (total orders in each segment)
segment_totals = df_filtered.groupby('customer_segment').size()
print("Segment totals:")
print(segment_totals)

# Compute weighted difference: sum(diff * proportion)
weighted_diff = (segment_diff * segment_totals / segment_totals.sum()).sum()
print(f"Weighted difference (email - paid_search): {weighted_diff:.4f}")

# Raw difference for comparison
email_rate = df_filtered[df_filtered['channel'] == 'email']['converted'].mean()
paid_search_rate = df_filtered[df_filtered['channel'] == 'paid_search']['converted'].mean()
raw_diff = email_rate - paid_search_rate
print(f"Raw difference (email - paid_search): {raw_diff:.4f}")

# Final value
final_diff = weighted_diff
print(f"Final adjusted difference: {final_diff:.4f}")"}
